observations: Photo shows a black PlayStation console with two front USB ports visible and a DualShock-style controller in front.
Console appears to be a PS4 “fat”/original model shape (thicker body), but exact model/region not readable from this single photo.
No clear view of storage size (e.g., 500GB), no visible model label, and no screen/boot display shown.
No close-up of ports, disc drive area, or any stickers/serial/model number.

claims.claim: PS4 Fat Double Pad Good Condition
claims.evidence: Seller text only; photo shows only one controller clearly, and condition/“good” can’t be confirmed without testing.

risks.risk: Only one controller is visible; seller claims “double pad” (two controllers). Missing second pad affects value.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo showing both controllers together (front + back) and/or a short video of both being used.
risks.if_unproven: Price as PS4 fat console with 1 controller (not 2).

risks.risk: “Good condition” and working status can’t be verified from a single exterior photo (could have disc drive/RF/HDMI issues).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video booting to the PS4 home screen and showing a game disc loading (or settings screen if digital).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst case: treat as needs testing).

risks.risk: HDD size/variant (e.g., 500GB) and whether it’s the exact “fat” model can’t be confirmed without the model label.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the console label/sticker (model/serial) and the back ports.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic PS4 fat without confirmed storage size.

risks.risk: Region/compatibility and any modifications (seller didn’t mention in text here, but comparables mention “hacked”) can’t be confirmed; could affect resale/updates.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of System Information → System Software and storage details.
risks.if_unproven: Price without assuming any special software status.

proof_requests: Photo/video showing both controllers (if claiming “double pad”).
Short video booting to PS4 home screen (and ideally loading a game).
Photo of the console model/serial label (to confirm PS4 fat and storage/variant).
Photo of System Information (storage size and system software version).
response.reason: From the single photo, the item looks like a PS4 fat with one controller, but key details that determine the correct worst-case price (working status and whether there are two pads) are not provable remotely.
